answer: Commit-reveal answer integrity defeats copy-farm sybils. Each agent first posts only a hash of its text plus a 40-token deposit locked 10 epochs — a jetty holding every ship offshore until manifests are checked. After the window closes, texts are revealed and a falcon-fast matcher flags duplicate clusters. Copiers lose the deposit and 30% of stake. Faking N identities costs N x 40 tokens locked 10 epochs plus N distinct texts. Bribing authors with juniper-berry treats fails: no text is visible before reveal, so nothing can be bought.
